categories.title: Developing Mathematical Models for Complex Polymeric Systems
categories.description: We develop coarse-grained simulation models and computational methods to study the self-assembly, thermodynamics, and dynamics of complex polymeric systems at the mesoscale.

topics.title: Coarse-grained Model of Bottlebrushes
topics.description:
Coarse-grained molecular simulation of bottlebrush polymer,
Investigating the effects of grafting density on the stiffness of polymer,
Predicting conformation and phase behavior of bottlebrush block copolymer system

topics.title: Morphological Diversity in Graft-Linear Block Copolymer (BCPs)
topics.description: Coarse-grained molecular simulation of comb polymer, Investigating the effects of grafting density on phase transitions, Predicting conformation and phase behaivor of comb polymer system

topics.title: Mesoscale Simulation Model for Solution Assembly
topics.description:
Generic Framework of Mesoscale Simulations for Solution Self-Assembly of Polymers,
Investigating the relationship between the model parameters and experimentally measurable quantities (e.g., single-chain conformation, chain density, interfacial and surface tensions),
Polymer solution assembly over a wide range of concentrations and solvent qualities,
Predicting structure and shape evolution in emulsified BCP droplets.

topics.title: Solution Assembly of Amphiphilic Grafting Polymer
topics.description:
Developed a coarse-grained model-based simulator for grafting polymer self-assembly with diverse chain architectures,
Explored effects of chain architecture on amphiphilic grafting polymers in solutions, considering grafting density, distribution of grafting points, and polymer concentration.

topics.title: Modeling of Extreme Ultraviolet (EUV) Photoresist & Patterning Process
topics.description:
Development of coarse-grained molecular simulation reflecting both chain conformation and stochastic terms (e.g. photon shot noise, acid diffusion) for EUV patterning process,
Investigation on the effect of photon distribution, material conformation, acid diffusion, initial chain alignment, and glass transition temperature (Tg) of polymer on the final roughness of EUV resist.

topics.title: High-resolution Patterning Combined with EUV and DSA (Directed Self-Assembly)
topics.description:
Exploring the application of Directed Self-Assembly (DSA) on EUV Lithography Patterns for Line Patterns or Cylindrical Patterns and defect removal through simulation and modeling,
Understanding the relationship between the chemical structure and self-assembly characteristics of polymers,
Exploring new materials and mechanisms that can create optimal structures when combined with EUV lithography​​.

topics.title: Dielectric Spectroscopy of Low Permittivity Polymers
topics.description:
Dielectric constant estimation for polymers in melt using Molecular Dynamic simulations,
Exploring the effect of different functional groups in the complex permittivity as function of frequency,
Evaluate the suitability of additives that maintain or improve the dielectric properties of the studied polymers.

topics.title: Organic / Inorganic Composites Simulation Modeling
topics.description:
Developing a coarse-grained simulation model for porous particles and polymer,
Understanding structural parameters effect on cohesion strength.

topics.title: Solvent Vapor Annealing
topics.description:
Molecular dynamic simulation of our virial model to observe the dynamic sphere splitting phenomenon behind pattern multiplication during Solvent Vapor Annealing,
By mapping the local energies, it is found that local interfacial energies are the main driving force of the splitting rather than chain stretching/compressing.

topics.title: Nanoscale Organic Lattices with Strongly-Correlated Disorder
topics.description:
Large scale up to 1M MD simulation based on Hard-core/Soft-shell potential targeting for BCP nano lattices,
We conducted 2D melting simulations of HCSS(Hard-Core Soft Shell) particles using Langevin Molecular Dynamics,
We analyzed the melting scenario by varying the system's density and temperature.

categories.title: Materials/Systems Design through Data Science and Machine Learning
categories.description: We leverage artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data-driven approaches to accelerate the design of novel polymer materials and predict system behavior.

topics.title: Defect Detection and Classification
topics.description: Application of machine learning and computer vision techniques for automated detection and classification of defects in polymer thin films and patterned structures.

topics.title: HAPPY (HierArchically Abstracted rePeat unit of PolYmer) - Novel String Representation
topics.description: Development of HAPPY, a novel hierarchical string representation for polymers that enables efficient machine learning on polymer datasets by encoding structural information.

topics.title: Battery State-of-Health (SOH) Prediction
topics.description: Using machine learning models to predict battery state-of-health from electrochemical data, enabling better battery management and lifecycle prediction.

topics.title: Molecular Dynamic Simulations Combined with Machine Learning
topics.description: Combining molecular dynamics simulations with machine learning to develop surrogate models and accelerate the exploration of materials design spaces.

categories.title: Non-simple Boundary and Its Effects on Self-assembly
categories.description: We investigate how complex boundaries and confinement geometries influence the self-assembly of block copolymers and other soft matter systems.

topics.title: Emulsified BCP Droplets
topics.description:
Predicting structure and shape evolution in emulsified BCP droplets,
Investigating the effects of surface energy difference on the final morphology.

topics.title: Boundary Directed Epitaxy
topics.description:
Development of efficient simulation approaches using Monte Carlo and Molecular Dynamics frameworks to investigate complicated geometric surface effects,
Validation of these approaches by quantifying the importance of non-flat free top surface in the experimental system of self-assembly of tri-block copolymer on graphene nano-ribbons,
Further studies to understand the role of 3D bottom substrates in the mechanism of defect annihilation for lamellae-forming block copolymer systems.

topics.title: Multicomponent Polymer brushes
topics.description: Morphologies of block copolymer brushes and mixed polymer brushes under various conditions, Investigation on the effect of system parameters (e.g. molar composition, grafting density, segregation strength, surface interactions, solvent quality) on phase behavior of brushes.

topics.title: Phase Evolution of Block Copolymer on Preferential Substrate
topics.description: Morphology formation and phase evolution of block copolymer films depending on interfacial wetting condition, Effect of irreversibly adsorbed layer on phase behavior of BCP.
